attributes.action: Classify ADHD as a neurodevelopmental condition, not a mental health condition
attributes.additional_details: Adults with diagnosed ADHD in the UK die 7 to 9 years earlier, linked to unmet support. When ADHD is filed under mental health, struggles caused by lack of support are blamed on the person. Frustration is recorded as instability or aggression, and children are punished instead of understood. Getting the label right would change how people are assessed, supported and listened to. It could save lives.
attributes.background: ADHD is neurodevelopmental, but the NHS, schools, social care and police often treat it as a mental illness. We want the Government to make all public services record and treat ADHD as neurodevelopmental, with trained staff, so people are supported, not blamed.

rejection.details:
The NHS already recognises ADHD as a neurodevelopmental disorder. 

You can read more about this here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/independent-review-into-mental-health-conditions-adhd-and-autism-final-report/independent-review-into-mental-health-conditions-adhd-and-autism-executive-summary
